title: 楽しい - fun

checks.check: quiz has 3-4 unique options and exactly one valid correct answer
quiz correct option equals the taught meaning
reveal slide matches the quiz answer
reveal slide repeats the same word and reading
audio transcript == subtitles (both generated from the same text)

uncertain: Level label N5 comes from unofficial community word lists (JLPT publishes no official vocabulary list).
Dialogue and example sentence were written by AI and have NOT been checked by a native speaker.
notes: Automated checks only prove internal consistency. They cannot prove the Japanese is natural or correct.
Vocabulary/grammar level was NOT machine-checked; compare against your N4 target by eye.

api_limits: Stories are single-media: each slide is posted as its own Story.
The Instagram API cannot add stickers (poll, quiz, link, question) or captions to Stories.
The API has no native scheduling: this project's scheduled workflow publishes at publish_at.
manual_steps: Optional: post the quiz slide by hand in the Instagram app and add the native Quiz sticker (options from the quiz slide, correct answer set) instead of the text-reply version.
Optional: add a Link sticker to the last Story by hand if you want a tappable link to the free lesson.
